title: See the Funny Side
html:
Imagine you are on the way to an important meeting…

You're dressed sharp. New suit or dress. Fresh shirt or blouse. You're feeling great!

Then -SPLAT!!

A seagull delivers a direct hit. Full payload. Centre mass.

Onyour fresh gear. Onyour big-meeting day.

The smell hits next - it ain't great.

Then the shock - oh no!

Then the panic as you realise:I'm about to walk into a room full of people like this.

For a moment, it feels like humiliation. Like the universe is taking the mickey and wants to embarrass you. You pause, breathe and feel something shift inside you.

You picture yourself from the outside: standing there, frozen in shock, wearing new gear with a seagull's "opinions" running down it.

And suddenly, you…laugh. A deep, ridiculous, can't-stop laugh.

Because sometimes life hands you a moment so absurd, so ridiculous, that laughter is the only correct response.

That laugh - that pause - saves your whole day.

It quiets the ego. Kills the tension. And hands you back control.

That's the real magic of humour. It's not just silliness, it's a pressure valve. It releases endorphins, resets your state, and reminds you that most "disasters" are only disasters because of the story you tell yourself.

Humour gives meaning to the mess.

It turns embarrassment into connection. It turns pain into perspective. And the best part? Anyone can fire off a laugh missile in their own brain at any time.

Adults need to laugh more. At themselves mainly.

This Week's Motivator

When something goes wrong, really wrong, take a second and imagine you're the funniest version of yourself. See the absurdity. Let your ego drop. And laughat the moment instead of letting the moment laugh at you. A simple laugh can turn a bad day into a way better story.

Prompt for the Week

What's one situation this week where you could choose humour over frustration? Where can you let the moment be funny instead of heavy?
